Details: Option of CreateModularModel: the weight label kf of every field, an exact rational such as 1/2 (actual modular weight -kf), as an association from field IDs.

Required (Automatic fails MissingFieldWeights); unknown field IDs or labels that are not exact rationals (for example 0.5) fail InvalidFieldWeights. A term with one form of weight kY is admitted when kY - Sum kf = kW.
Option of CreateModularModel: the actual modular weight kW of the model's target expression.
An exact rational, default 0; every monomial of every term must have total actual weight kW (fields -kf, forms kY).
Option of ModularContractions and ModularTensorProductVectors: which formal form slots are appended.

All (default) is exhaustive and needs every relevant form-space count (otherwise IncompleteModularSpace); a space established by SupplyModularFormSpace counts, conditional on the user's spanning claim; a duplicate-free list of slot IDs from the candidate report gives selected coverage.
Option of AddModularFormCouplings: the per-slot coefficients.
Automatic (default) makes a fresh coupling per selected slot; an association from exactly the selected slot IDs to coefficients uses those (declare symbols with ParameterSymbols).
Option of BindModularForms: whether existing bindings of the given slots may be replaced.
False (default) fails AlreadyBound; True replaces them and checks the combined bound set of every affected space again.
Option of ValidateModularModel: whether every used slot must be bound.
False (default) reports the binding status; True fails MissingBindings unless every used slot is bound with full independent coverage of its space.
Option of EvaluateModularModel and EvaluateModularMassMatrix: the values of the fields the expression needs.
An association from field IDs to full ordered vectors of finite numbers (default <||>); a required field without a value fails MissingFieldValues, a wrong length InvalidFieldValues.
FormComponent[slotID, i] is the inert i-th component of a formal modular-form slot of a modular model (a symbolic Y copy); N leaves it unevaluated.
Slot IDs come from ModularFormCandidates; a model registers a slot when a term using it is added, and only registered slot components may appear in a modular model's terms.
